name: PAR LED RGB 3ch
note: The Brisas BX-940 on the bar are 5 ch (R,G,B,W,A) but they are patched every 3: the W/A of each one lands on the neighbour's R/G/B. While the rig stays like that, the fixture IS a 3 ch one. A 4 ch RGBW profile at a spacing of 3 becomes a PatchError, and that is the right behaviour.
